what_it_is: A macOS PCSX2 2.3.319 user's file card named SLUS-20552.ps2 (the serial of GTA: Vice City, whose save BASLUS-20552GTA40000 it holds, with the console's BADATA-SYSTEM folder), attached to a Hitman: Blood Money report; the same zip also had a folder-card save directory, not filed.
note: No licence stated on the page. raw card SLUS-20552.ps2 (per-game name) + one folder-card save dir
